purpose: AI planning model for compute/API/storage/evidence cost without inventing provider prices.
truth_rule: Numeric monetary prices are UNKNOWN unless a current authorized source supplies them.

resource_classes.name: External model inference
optimization_rules: Use heterogeneous agents; cheap model may perform preliminary work when authorized.
Kill failed candidates early.
Do not call every strongest model by default.
Critical verification may justify higher-capability models.
hard_constraints: Cost optimization may not bypass required proof/release gates.

resource_classes.name: DOC-C pipeline compute
optimization_rules: Bound work by pipeline timeouts.
No automatic retry by default.
Exclude noncritical timed-out worker only if quorum/release semantics remain legal.

resource_classes.name: Metadata / blob / history storage
optimization_rules: Metadata in PostgreSQL; large payloads in object/blob storage per DOC-C direction.
Preserve immutable lineage; cost reduction cannot rewrite audit/history.
Archive may move older data to warm/cold classes when design permits.
hard_constraints: artifact/revision retention according to deletion policy

resource_classes.name: Lo2 verified knowledge corpus
optimization_rules: Compress verified solutions into reusable Logic Quanta/Laws.
Deduplicate/generalize rather than treating every raw conversation as permanent intelligence.
Keep raw artifacts/evidence separate from compressed knowledge where architecture permits.
hard_constraints: Unverified raw user data must not become authoritative law.

resource_classes.name: AAAA Game Fabric resources
optimization_rules: Render/GPU work may scale independently from authoritative simulation.
Use bounded world/chunk/agent budgets.
Cloud assist cannot write sovereign state directly.
hard_constraints: resource overload must be locally contained

resource_classes.name: Robotics compute/hardware
optimization_rules: Fast Path avoids expensive deep reasoning on immediate reflexes.
Use bounded mini-swarm for critical/non-reflex decisions.
hard_constraints: Independent safety path cannot be removed for cost.
Physical proof cannot be replaced by simulation alone when physical claim is made.

resource_classes.name: Verification / evidence generation
optimization_rules: Run smallest decisive proof first, then impacted regression.
Reuse navigation/history, not stale proof.
Do not skip evidence to reduce cost.
hard_constraints: Required evidence class must match claim.
DOC-E exact-current evidence required for deployability.

decision_heuristic: Then minimize external model calls, compute, storage and repeated exploration.
Prefer verified reusable context/skills over re-analysis.
Never trade correctness/integrity for cost without explicit policy allowing degraded behavior.
unknowns: No canonical provider API price table is stored.
No current production cloud bill/capacity plan is established.
No canonical bytes-per-Logic-Quantum or Lo2 storage compression ratio is defined.
No current hardware procurement price should be inferred from historical source examples.
